When you top up your credit or buy a Travelcard or Bus & Tram Pass, it will be available to collect after 30 minutes when you touch your Oyster card on a yellow card reader as part of a journey on any London bus, or at any Tube, DLR, London Overground, TfL Rail or National Rail station within the pay as you go area, tram stop or River Bus pier.
 
Keeping on top of your spend is easy; see the date, time and cost of your journeys from the last 8 weeks.

Before the flight

This way you can rest assured that you’re up to date with all your flight information.
During the flight
•	Flight ticket and onboard services: You always have your mobile boarding pass and onboard services to hand thanks to the Brussels App – even when you don’t have internet access. All relevant flight information is at your fingertips, so you know your flight status without having to ask the flight crew.
After the flight
•	Track baggage: Your digital travel companion will still be at your side even after you’ve arrived at your destination. Locate your checked-in baggage in the app and stay informed about the subsequent parts of your trip.
